timeout.recommendation: Add 5000ms timeout to the http.Client used in pwn.New(). Replace http.DefaultClient with &http.Client{Timeout: 5*time.Second}

retry.recommendation: Add single retry with 1s backoff for transient network errors

circuit_breaker.recommendation: Consider circuit breaker if this API is called frequently; for admin-only user creation, may not be critical

fallback.behavior: On API failure, error is wrapped as ErrIsPwnedRequest and logged; user creation is rejected with 400. The check can be disabled via PasswordCheckPwn=false config.
fallback.recommendation: Consider allowing user creation to proceed with a warning when the API is unreachable, rather than blocking

idempotency.reason: GET request to read-only API, no side effects

blast_radius.impact: If HaveIBeenPwned is down and PasswordCheckPwn=true, all admin user creation requests fail with 400

findings.detail: EditSystemHook does SELECT, then editHook (UPDATE), then re-SELECT. If concurrent modification occurs between operations, stale data could be returned. However, this is admin-only and unlikely to have concurrent access.

non_atomic_operations: SELECT + UPDATE + SELECT without transaction wrapper

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: None - all operations in single transaction

findings.detail: HaveIBeenPwned API call uses http.DefaultClient with no timeout. Request can hang indefinitely.
findings.recommendation: Set Timeout: 5*time.Second on the HTTP client

findings.detail: No retry logic for transient network failures to HaveIBeenPwned
findings.recommendation: Add single retry with backoff for network errors

findings.detail: No circuit breaker for HaveIBeenPwned API
findings.recommendation: Low priority for admin-only endpoint; consider if bulk user creation is common

findings.detail: Fallback exists: PasswordCheckPwn config can disable the check entirely. When API fails, error is logged and user creation is rejected.
findings.recommendation: Consider graceful degradation: allow creation with warning when API is unreachable

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: HaveIBeenPwned down → all admin user creation blocked (if PasswordCheckPwn=true)
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Can be disabled via PasswordCheckPwn=false config

graceful_shutdown.detail: Gitea uses modules/graceful for graceful shutdown with signal handling

rate_limiting.detail: No rate limiting on admin API endpoints
rate_limiting.recommendation: Admin endpoints are protected by auth; rate limiting is low priority

dead_letter_queues.detail: These endpoints are synchronous; mailer uses internal queue

single_points_of_failure: HaveIBeenPwned API (for user creation with PasswordCheckPwn=true)
cascading_failure_paths: HaveIBeenPwned API down → ep-098 user creation fails with 400
